description: Controlled vocabulary defining aggregate types used in the material_batches tab of the Concrete Grand Challenge Experimental Database.

entries.definition: Aggregate primarily composed of basaltic rock.
Aggregate primarily composed of calcium-carbonate-bearing rock or calcareous material.
Aggregate primarily composed of dolomite or dolomitic rock.
Aggregate primarily composed of granite or granitic rock.
Crushed gravel aggregate produced by mechanical crushing of gravel particles.
Natural gravel aggregate obtained from natural deposits without crushing as the primary processing step.
Aggregate primarily composed of limestone.
Lightweight aggregate produced from expanded clay.
Lightweight aggregate based on pumice.
Lightweight aggregate produced from expanded or processed shale.
Lightweight aggregate produced from expanded or processed slate.
Fine aggregate produced by mechanical crushing or industrial processing.
Natural fine aggregate obtained from natural sand deposits.
Aggregate primarily composed of quartzite.
Aggregate produced from crushed recycled concrete.
Aggregate produced from crushed recycled masonry materials.
Rounded or subrounded gravel aggregate obtained from river or alluvial deposits.
Aggregate primarily composed of sandstone.
Aggregate primarily composed of silica-rich or siliceous material.
Aggregate produced from metallurgical slag.
Aggregate type that does not fall within the predefined categories.
Aggregate type not reported or not identifiable from the available documentation.
